tool.name: Savont export
tool.description: Merge Savont results from several samples into QIIME2-compatible files
tool.command: #set $relabel_str = ' '.join([str(r.get('label')).strip() for r in $runs if str(r.get('label') or '').strip()]) #for $i, $run in enumerate($runs) mkdir -p 'run_$i' && ln -sf '$run.asv_fasta' 'run_$i/final_asvs.fasta' #if $run.feature_table && ln -sf '$run.feature_table' 'run_$i/feature-table.tsv' #end if #if $run.asv_mappings && ln -sf '$run.asv_mappings' 'run_$i/asv_mappings.tsv' #end if && #end for savont export -i #for $i, $run in enumerate($runs) 'run_$i' #end for -o 'export_out' $no_fuzzy #if $relabel_str --relabel $relabel_str #end if && cp export_out/savont_*.log '$output_log'

repeat.name: runs
repeat.title: Savont run
repeat.help: One entry per sample: the ASV sequences and the feature table of a **Savont ASV** run.

param.name: asv_mappings
param.label: ASV mappings
param.help: Optional ``asv_mappings.tsv`` from **Savont classify** or **Savont SINTAX** on this sample. Supplying mappings enables the merged taxonomy output.

param.name: label
param.label: Sample names
param.help: Optional space-separated list of replacement names for the samples of this run in the merged outputs: one name per sample column of the run's feature table (a run without a feature table has exactly one sample). Names consist of letters and numbers only. The total number of names across all runs must equal the total number of sample columns; **savont** fails the export if it does not. If no names are given, the sample names embedded in the feature tables are used.

validator.message: Sample names may only contain letters and numbers, separated by single spaces (one name per sample)

param.name: no_fuzzy
param.label: Keep all ASVs separate
param.help: By default, ASVs that are 10 bp shorter or longer than another ASV but 100% identical to it are merged. Check this box to keep all ASVs separate (not recommended).

tool.help:
**Savont export** merges the results of several **Savont ASV** runs (one per sample) into a set of QIIME2-compatible files.
The ASVs of all samples are dereplicated: sequences that are identical, or that are 10 bp shorter or longer but 100% identical to another ASV, are merged into a single feature, so the merged feature table is directly usable in QIIME2. If ASV mappings from **Savont classify** or **Savont SINTAX** are supplied for some samples, the merged taxonomy file contains the taxonomy of each merged feature (samples without mappings are reported as *Unclassified*).
Inputs ------
* **Savont run**: one entry per sample, with the ``final_asvs.fasta`` and ``feature-table.tsv`` outputs of **Savont ASV**, and optionally the ``asv_mappings.tsv`` of **Savont classify** / **Savont SINTAX**. * **Sample names** *(optional, per run)*: a space-separated list of replacement names for the samples of that run in the merged outputs — one name per sample column of the run's feature table, letters and numbers only. The total number of names across all runs must equal the total number of sample columns; **savont** fails the export if it does not. If no names are given, the sample names embedded in the feature tables are used.
Outputs -------
* **Merged feature table**: QIIME2-compatible feature table, one column per sample. * **Merged representative sequences**: one sequence per merged feature. * **Merged ASV taxonomy**: taxonomy per merged feature. * **Merged taxon counts**: human-readable count table per taxon and sample.
